name: rosetta-decorate-sort-undecorate-idiom-02-schwartzian-transform
code:
use default

schwartzian[T, K: Ghul.Comparable[K]]
    (items: Iterable[T], key: (T) -> K) -> Pipe[T]
=>
    items
        |> map(item => (item, key = key(item)))
        |> sort_by(pair => pair.key)
        |> map(pair => pair.item)

let words =
    ["Rosetta", "Code", "is", "a", "programming", "chrestomathy", "site"]

write_line(words |> schwartzian(w => w.length) |> join(", "))
write_line(words |> schwartzian(w => w[0]) |> join(", "))
